About the play partner:  
SoCal Drum Party, led by Mike Enriquez, features a diverse team of drummers and music therapists bringing the joy of drumming to events across Southern California. We work with all ages, from toddlers to seniors, and support people with special needs. Our mission is simple: to share the joy and power of drumming with as many people as possible. We believe drumming is a force for good, and we’ve seen it make a difference in people’s lives.

Included in museum admission. Space is limited! Book your tickets now.
*Members do not require a reservation.
*Events and dates are subject to change.
About the play partner: 
Niagara Cares is the heart of what we do and who we are at Niagara Bottling. For more than 60 years, we have been making a difference for our Team Members, consumers and communities through philanthropic giving, volunteering, water donations, and disaster relief. As a family-owned business, we are committed to creating meaningful change for our communities through a spirit of giving back both big and small. For more information, visitniagarawater.com/niagara-cares.
Frequently Asked Questions:
Is Sustainable Saturdays included with museum admission?
Yes. All Sustainable Saturdays activities are included with regular museum admission. 
When does Sustainable Saturdays take place?
Sustainable Saturdays is held on the fourth Saturday of every month in the Art Studio.

events.title: A Slice of Literary Orange -  Walter Mosley
events.display_title: [FREE] A Slice of Literary Orange -  Walter Mosley
events.description:
A Slice of Literary Orange presents: Walter Mosley. Walter Mosley is one of America’s most celebrated writers. He was given the 2020 National Book Award’s Medal for Distinguished Contribution to American Letters, named a Grand Master of the Mystery Writers of America, and honored with the Anisfield-Wolf Award, a Grammy, a PEN USA Lifetime Achievement Award, the Robert Kirsch Award, numerous Edgars, and several NAACP Image Awards. His work has been translated into twenty-five languages. He has published fiction and nonfiction in The New Yorker, Playboy, and The Nation. As an executive producer, he adapted his novel The Last Days of Ptolemy Grey for AppleTV . He co-wrote the adaptation of his novel The Man in My Basement to stream on Hulu, and he served as a writer and executive producer for FX’s Snowfall. He divides his time between Brooklyn and Santa Monica.

Tustin Library 345 E. Main St, Tustin, CA 92780

Limited complimentary books available, while supplies last.

Admission does not guarantee a free copy. No registration required. Early arrival suggested.

11am – Flower Songs Music present by Segerstrom Center for the Arts
12pm-2pm – Sugar Skull Decorating Drop In

Space is limited! Book your tickets now; this program is included in museum admission.

About the play partners:
Flower Songs Music shares culture, history, instruments, and songs in English, Spanish, and native languages. This family of musicians, poets, researchers, and educators, aim to share their rich culture while fostering community and inclusivity.
Arts Teach is an education program by Segerstrom Center for the Arts that offers assembly performances and workshops in Dance, Music, Theater, and Visual Arts for schools and community organizations. 
Relámpago del Cielo 
Relámpago del Cielo, Inc. Grupo Folklórico celebrates 45 years in Santa Ana as the oldest operating non-profit institution of its kind within the region and the largest in the United States. 
Over the years, RDC has touched the lives of generations in the community, offering low-cost Mexican Folkloric dance classes for all ages, dance recitals, and special performances locally and internationally.

events.title: Recycling Day at Pretend City
events.description:
Pretend City Children’s Museum teamed up with OC Waste & Recycling to bring hands-on vermicomposting education to young learners! Through interactive presentations and activities, kids explore how worms help recycle food scraps into nutrient-rich compost, leaning firsthand how small actions can make a big impact for our planet! Together, we’re making organics recycling fun, engaging, and accessible for the next generation of environmental stewards.
Time: 11am-1pm
Included with Museum admission Activities take place throughout the day while supplies last.
*Events and times are subject to change.

About the play partner: 
OC Wast & Recycle serves the County’s solid waste disposal needs by providing waste management services, operating public landfills, protecting the local environment, investing in renewable energy enterprises and promoting recycling in order to ensure a safe and healthy community for current and future generations. OCWR also provides education, outreach, and sustainability programs that help residents reduce waste and support state and local mandates.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is Getting Wiggly with Composting program?
Getting Wiggly with Composting is a hands-on environmental learning experience at Pretend City Children’s Museum in Irvine, California, where children discover how worms turn food scraps into nutrient-rich compost through vermicomposting.
Is this activity included with admission?
Yes. The vermicomposting activities are included with regular museum admission.
What ages is this program best for?
The experience is designed for children ages 3–12 and their families.
Will kids see real worms?
Yes. Children can learn about real worms and how they help break down food scraps into compost.
